Graduate Program Requirements
Requirements
Full details of current Graduate School requirements can be obtained from the Chair of the Graduate Admissions and Assistantship Committee.
Graduates of colleges and universities in the United States require a minimum of:
A bachelor's degree from a United States college or university accredited by the cognizant regional accrediting agency.
Undergraduate preparation in the proposed major field equivalent to that acquired by a graduate of KSU in the proposed field of study, or evidence of an appropriate background for undertaking an advanced degree program.
An undergraduate average of B (3.0) or better in the junior and senior years.
Read and download the current, and past, "Requirements and Regulations for Advanced Degrees"
Support
The financial support for our graduate students have improved dramatically during the last couple of years. We are now able to offer very competitive stipends to our Ph.D. students, and you should also know that we are enjoying relatively low costs of living in Manhattan, which should make graduate studies at Kansas State particularly appealing.
We offer a competitive base stipend as well as many opportunities for additional support (these are awarded on academic merits), which can raise the basic stipend up to an additional $5,000. We also provide health insurance and cover tuition. For more information about financial support contact our graduate program admissions chair.
